biggest_catch: Limited-time offer for students only — you must be enrolled at least half-time at a college or university, and never buy extra just to hit the $300 threshold.
catches: Never spend extra solely to chase the $300 threshold — only use spending you already planned.
The card has no annual fee, so there is no fee drag on the $100 net value — but carrying a balance at the regular variable APR erases the bonus, so pay in full every month.
Applying involves a hard credit inquiry when Discover processes the application.
Eligibility: must be a student enrolled at least half-time at a college or university; income/savings requirements apply.
This is a LIMITED-TIME offer — the $100-after-$300 terms can change or be pulled; confirm the banner is still on discover.com before applying.

The first-year unlimited Cashback Match is a separate, variable benefit (depends on your own spending) and is NOT part of this verified $100 payout; the $100 statement credit itself is not doubled by the match.
